### Niagen Bioscience to Present at LD Micro 20th Annual Main Event


October 6, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/770776702/files/doc_news/Niagen-Bioscience-to-Present-at-LD-Micro-20th-Annual-Main-Event-2026.pdf)


LOS ANGELES--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Niagen Bioscience, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com%2F&esheet=54616589&newsitemid=20261006449816&lan=en-US&anchor=Niagen+Bioscience%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=9570790685e58dd454f2506fcac22772) (NASDAQ: NAGE), the global authority on NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) with a focus on the science of healthy aging, today announces that senior management will participate in the 20th Annual LD Micro Main Event from Monday, October 19 to 21, 2026, in Los Angeles, CA.


Niagen Bioscience Chief Executive Officer, Robert Fried, will present on Wednesday, October 21st at 1:30 p.m. PT. To register for the Niagen Bioscience webcast, please visit[www.ldmicroevents.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.ldmicroevents.com&esheet=54616589&newsitemid=20261006449816&lan=en-US&anchor=www.ldmicroevents.com&index=2&md5=434d535d81cab45b032a6e8a187906f2) .


Chief Financial Officer, Ozan Pamir, will join Mr. Fried and be available for one-on-one meetings with institutional investors at the conference. If you would like to schedule a one-on-one meeting with the Niagen Bioscience management team during the conference, please contact your respective conference representative or emailNiagen@KCSA.com .


A replay of the presentation webcast will be available on the Niagen Bioscience Investor Relations website,[www.investors.niagenbioscience.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.niagenbioscience.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54616589&newsitemid=20261006449816&lan=en-US&anchor=www.investors.niagenbioscience.com&index=3&md5=4c136f38b855d8948d75ef525242fe1b) , following the event.


For additional information on Niagen Bioscience, visit[www.niagenbioscience.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com&esheet=54616589&newsitemid=20261006449816&lan=en-US&anchor=www.niagenbioscience.com&index=4&md5=af34a0a97e9dd7dccf2d1fdff2e46fb5) .


**About Niagen Bioscience:**


[Niagen Bioscience, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com%2F&esheet=54616589&newsitemid=20261006449816&lan=en-US&anchor=Niagen+Bioscience%2C+Inc.&index=5&md5=e4d63cab3de789407ab8688829cb16d9) (NASDAQ: NAGE) is the global authority in NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) science and healthy-aging research. As a trusted pioneer of NAD+ discoveries, Niagen Bioscience™ is dedicated to advancing healthspan through precision science and innovative NAD+-boosting solutions.


The Niagen Bioscience team, composed of world-renowned scientists, works with independent investigators from esteemed universities and research institutions around the globe to uncover the full potential of NAD+. A vital coenzyme found in every cell of the human body, NAD+ declines with age and exposure to everyday lifestyle stressors. NAD+ depletion is a key contributor to age-related changes in health and vitality.


Distinguished by state-of-the-art laboratories, rigorous scientific and quality protocols, and collaborations with leading research institutions worldwide, Niagen Bioscience sets the gold standard for research, quality, and innovation. There’s a better way to age.


At the heart of its clinically proven product portfolio is Niagen® (patented nicotinamide riboside, or NR), the most efficient, well-researched, and high-quality NAD+ booster available. Niagen powers the Company’s consumer supplement, Tru Niagen®, the number one NAD+ boosting oral supplement in the United States† (available at[www.truniagen.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.truniagen.com&esheet=54616589&newsitemid=20261006449816&lan=en-US&anchor=www.truniagen.com&index=6&md5=3f5a5acab3cdbdafa92782a87552f797) ), and Niagen™ Plus, featuring pharmaceutical-grade intravenous (IV) and injectable Niagen products ([www.niagenplus.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenplus.com&esheet=54616589&newsitemid=20261006449816&lan=en-US&anchor=www.niagenplus.com&index=7&md5=05107e6eff071309eeddd9663916b48f) ). Pharmaceutical-grade Niagen IV and injections are compounded and distributed by U.S. FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facilities and are available exclusively at clinics with a prescription.


Niagen Bioscience’s robust patent portfolio protects NR and other NAD+ precursors. Niagen Bioscience maintains a website at[www.niagenbioscience.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com&esheet=54616589&newsitemid=20261006449816&lan=en-US&anchor=www.niagenbioscience.com&index=8&md5=25b368ec07430e35c3f72caab9a1ec04) , where copies of press releases, news, and financial information are regularly published.


† *Based on revenue per largest U.S. e-commerce marketplace (Jan. 2025 – Dec. 2025)*
